title: DAAD Konrad Zuse School of Excellence in Reliable Artificial Intelligence (relAI): Scholarship for Master's Students and PhD Candidates
summary: Scholarships for international Master's students and PhD candidates in artificial intelligence and related subjects at relAI in Germany.

subject_areas.notes: Artificial Intelligence and related subjects, computer science, mathematics, engineering, natural sciences or other data science/machine learning/AI related disciplines

nationality.notes: DAAD origin-unspecified page with a country selection list; specific eligible countries are not enumerated in the static text.

residence.notes: Country is the country in which you are living and from which you are applying.

mandatory.text: highly qualified current or prospective Master's students and PhD candidates who have achieved excellent results in previous studies
pursue studies in Artificial Intelligence, broadly conceived

excellent Bachelor's degree / Master's degree (for application for MSc / PhD respectively) in computer science, mathematics, engineering, natural sciences or other data science/machine learning/AI related disciplines
genuine interest to work on a topic of reliableAI, covering aspects such as safety, security, privacy and responsibility in one of relAI’s research areas
proof of English language proficiency: level C1 or equivalent (also acceptable: proof that previous university degree was taught mainly in English)

PhD programme only: choice of 2 preferred supervisors who are relAI Fellows, along with a short explanation (max. 1,000 characters) for each why the respective supervisor would be a good fit; names and addresses of 2 researchers who consent to be contacted for recommendation letters

funding.description: Information about the scholarship is published in the annual call for applications.
funding.duration: standard duration of the Master's programme or 3 years for the PhD programme

application_rounds.notes: Open calls are published on the website.

required_documents.text: copies of relevant diplomas and transcripts
motivation letter, also highlighting previous experience in the field, e.g. in Bachelor's or Master's thesis
mention of the preferred research area
proof of English language proficiency: level C1 or equivalent (also acceptable: proof that previous university degree was taught mainly in English)
